headline: Israeli strike kills Hamas internal security chief
pages: Israeli air strikes in the Gaza Strip killed at least seven Palestinians on Tuesday, including the head of Hamas's internal security service, health officials and first responders said. Naeem Abu Nahel, 50, was targeted in western Gaza City, according to the Hamas-run interior ministry. He had held the post only since September, when his predecessor was captured in an Israeli raid. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz said he was eliminated. Witnesses said a drone hit him on a side street near a tent camp for displaced people. Six others died in two earlier strikes, including three at a police station in al-Mawasi.
Gaza's police said the strikes are a campaign to sow chaos. Israel said it hit military operatives. Source: BBC News.
